{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
refunded_mask = data['status'] == 'refunded'
data_clean = data[~(qa_mask | refunded_mask)]

# Compute raw conversion rates by channel
raw_conv_rates = data_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
email_rate_raw = raw_conv_rates['email']
paid_search_rate_raw = raw_conv_rates['paid_search']
effect_raw = email_rate_raw - paid_search_rate_raw

# Print the raw effect as required by the question
print(f"Raw conversion rate (email): {email_rate_raw:.4f}")
print(f"Raw conversion rate (paid_search): {paid_search_rate_raw:.4f}")
print(f"Raw effect (email - paid_search): {effect_raw:.4f}")

# Return for submission
effect_raw"}
